# EV.ENGINEER

> EV.ENGINEER is an engineering-education platform and brand publishing
> content, internships and student project tracks in EV battery systems,
> Battery Management Systems, automotive and battery cybersecurity,
> autonomous vehicle systems, and aerospace and space engineering
> (including a model rocketry learning guide). The site is operated by
> iTelematics Software Private Limited. Space is an ISHAVASYAM.ORG education,
> research and engineering initiative. EV Society is a separate community
> initiative; EV.ENGINEER, ISHAVASYAM.ORG and EV Society are distinct entities
> and are not merged here.

This file is an experimental discovery aid for AI agents and language
models. It is not a replacement for crawlable HTML, structured data
(JSON-LD), the XML sitemap, or conventional SEO — see those first. Every
link below points to a canonical public page already listed in
/sitemap.xml.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/): Lithium-Ion EV Battery
  Intelligence Platform — overview of EV.ENGINEER.
- [About](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/about): What EV.ENGINEER builds
  and its focus areas.
- [Internships](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/internships): Canonical hub
  for EV, battery, cybersecurity, autonomous-systems, aerospace, space and
  model-rocketry internships and student projects.
- [AQIP — Aerospace Quality Intelligence Platform](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/internships/aerospace-quality-intelligence-platform):
  Strategy and operating manual for an early-stage initiative to build the
  quality intelligence and evidence layer for aerospace and defence
  manufacturing: First Article Inspection (FAI) as the starting point, the
  Aerospace Quality Graph, a 3D Inspection Twin concept (a verified 3D
  reconstruction from a 2D drawing, shown as a synthetic demonstration and
  never as authoritative CAD), cybersecurity and digital trust, AI assurance
  with bounded agents and human approval, a three-year roadmap and five-year
  vision, customer discovery and validation playbooks, business model, risks,
  FAQ and glossary. What exists is the FAI Engineer prototype foundation; the
  rest is labelled in development, planned, research or long-term vision. An
  EV Society initiative; commercial product development through iTelematics
  Software Private Limited.
- [AegisCAN](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/internships/AegisCAN): 12-week
  educational R&D mini-project on Battery, BMS, BESS, CAN communication,
  validation, fault injection and CAN cybersecurity. Initiated and led by
  Tanuja Jadhav (Lead Researcher · EV.ENGINEER™), with Bhavya Naga Sai
  Parvathi Kshatri (Cybersecurity Researcher · EV.ENGINEER™), Harsh Yadav
  (Co-Researcher · EV.ENGINEER™, aerospace cybersecurity research and
  AS9102 First Article Inspection engineering focus) and Sudarshana Karkala
  (Co-Researcher · EV.ENGINEER™).
- [EV Battery Health & Diagnostics Toolkit](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/internships/ev-battery-health-diagnostics-toolkit):
  EV.ENGINEER™ interactive 3D workspace for electric-scooter battery
  diagnosis: Owner Mode (symptoms and safe next steps only) and Technician
  Mode, a vehicle battery locator, fixed / swappable / serviceable
  architectures, a 3D battery explorer, a BMS digital twin, simulated fault
  injection, an evidence-gated real vehicle diagnosis workflow, repair
  decisions, post-repair verification and a diagnostic report. Simulated
  values are labelled SIMULATED; vehicle battery specifications are shown as
  not verified until a source is recorded. It does not replace manufacturer
  service documentation.
- [EVeium Battery Diagnostics](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/internships/ev-battery-health-diagnostics-toolkit/vehicles/eveium):
  Real-vehicle battery diagnosis for EVeium Cosmo, Comet and Czar within the
  toolkit. Publicly documented 72 V lithium-ion specifications with sources
  (Cosmo 30 Ah, Comet 50 Ah; Czar capacity sources disagree: 40 Ah per the
  manufacturer website, 42 Ah per 2022 launch coverage). Cell chemistry,
  format, BMS protocol, connector and battery location are listed as not
  verified. No live BMS connection.
- [Cybersecurity Engineers](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/internships/cybersecurity-engineers):
  Profiles of engineers and researchers contributing to cybersecurity research
  at EV.ENGINEER — Bhavya Naga Sai Parvathi Kshatri (Cybersecurity Researcher ·
  EV.ENGINEER™) — with links to public profiles and to the related
  cybersecurity programs.
- [Sudarshana Karkala](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/about/sudarshana-karkala):
  Sudarshana Karkala — EV.ENGINEER™, Founder of ISHAVASYAM.ORG, engineering
  leader and consultant across Space research, Digital Twins, Cybersecurity,
  EV and energy systems. Canonical public profile, with his professional
  background (20+ years in engineering and technology; Space and Aerospace
  are his more recent research focus), consulting engagements,
  professional and community leadership, academic engagement and student
  mentorship, initiatives, selected work and contact channels.
- [Contact](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/contact): Public business
  contact details for iTelematics Software Private Limited.
- [Trust Center](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/trust-center): Verified
  feedback and professional recognition, used as the evidence destination
  for claims made across this site.

## Space and aerospace

- [Space](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/space): An ISHAVASYAM.ORG
  education, research and engineering initiative in aerospace and space
  engineering.
- [Model Rocketry Learning Guide](https://autonomous.ev.engineer/space/2026-INSPACe-ROCKETRY-059):
  An independent, beginner-friendly seven-day model rocketry guide. Not an
  official IN-SPACe or ISRO publication.

## Entity distinctions

- EV.ENGINEER: platform/brand, not a separate registered legal entity.
- iTelematics Software Private Limited: the legal company operating
  EV.ENGINEER, per /contact.
- ISHAVASYAM.ORG: the organisation the Space initiative belongs to
  (https://ishavasyam.org/). Its legal form is not published on this site.
- EV Society: a separate community initiative, not a registered Section 8
  company per any evidence published on this site.
- Sudarshana Karkala: a person — Founder of ISHAVASYAM.ORG, Co-Founder ·
  Director of Thasmai InfoTech Private Limited, and Co-Founder of Gamyaa
  AeroSystems.
  His work with iTelematics Software Private Limited, Skill-Lync, Schaeffler
  India, Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals and iFab Innovations is
  consulting engagements, not employment or partnership. The engineering
  institutions on his profile are places of student engagement and
  mentoring, not employers or partners. He is a Founding Member of EV
  Society™ and a Core Team Member of the NITK Surathkal Alumni Association's
  NITKSAA Alumni Digital Ecosystem: community and alumni contributions, not
  employment by EV Society™, NITK or the Association. EV.ENGINEER is the engineering
  identity of his team and the projects they build together; it is not a
  founder title.
- IN-SPACe and ISRO: external government organisations referenced only as
  the publisher of the model-rocketry workshop this site's learning guide
  is based on. No endorsement, certification or partnership is implied.

## Public source documentation referenced by this site

## CubeTwin

- [CubeTwin](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/cubesat): ISHAVASYAM.ORG educational R&D CubeSat energy simulator, 12-week guide and printable workbook. Simulated data; not flight software.

## Satellite Engineering

- [Satellite Engineering](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/satellite-engineering): An EV.ENGINEER advanced 12-week Architecture & Leadership Track, "From First Principles to Spacecraft Systems Architect", within the ISHAVASYAM.ORG Space initiative, for systems leads, principal engineers, engineering managers, CTOs, chief architects and senior R&D engineers. Covers mission system-of-systems architecture, spacecraft subsystem architecture, engineering budgets and margin policy, architecture decision records, software assurance, EEE parts and product assurance, a satellite digital twin (an engineering model, not a validated flight twin), a CubeSat-class educational flatsat (not flight-qualified), and formal review gates in lifecycle order (MCR, SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, ORR, MRR). Completion does not confer job titles.
- [Satellite Explorer 3D](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/satellite-engineering/interactive-3d): Interactive 3D model of an educational 6U Earth-observation reference satellite. Build the spacecraft, open it in exploded and X-ray views, follow power, data and RF flows, and run an end-to-end mission from boot to payload downlink. Reference and simulated values; not flight hardware or a real mission. The full 3D experience is designed for laptop and desktop screens; phones get a compact subsystem overview.

## Rocket Engine Digital Twin

- [Next-Generation Rocket Engine Digital Twin](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/rocket-engine-digital-twin): An EV.ENGINEER interactive 3D digital-engineering learning environment for a reusable liquid rocket engine reference architecture. Open the engine, follow propellant, cooling and hot-gas flows, cut into the turbomachinery and combustion chamber, run a simulated engine test, follow a bearing degradation fault from sensor to diagnosis, and compare observed, estimated, expected and predicted digital twin states. Reference and simulated values; not a real, production or flight engine, and not correlated with test data. The 3D application is designed for laptop and desktop screens; phones get a lightweight schematic version.
- [Advanced Rocket Propulsion System Digital Twin](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/rocket-engine-digital-twin-advanced): An EV.ENGINEER interactive engineering tutorial on turning an operating liquid propulsion system into a Digital Twin for pressure monitoring, fault detection, diagnosis and prognostics. Twelve modules cover the propulsion system, the pressure network and its sensors, physics-based and reduced-order models, data acquisition and telemetry quality, state estimation and sensor fusion, residuals, physics-informed AI/ML, FDIR, prognostics with uncertainty, model credibility and V&V, platform architecture and cybersecurity, and a 12-week assignment. A simulated twin runs in the browser with eleven injectable faults. Generic reference architecture and simulated telemetry; not a proprietary, production or flight engine, not correlated with test data, and not a flight-certification or flight-safety authority.

## APEX Rocket Systems — engineering collaboration concept

A concept experience, developed as an engineering collaboration proposal, about APEX Rocket Systems (official website: https://www.apexrocketsystems.com/). APEX has built a 5 kN-class gas-generator-cycle liquid-engine demonstrator as part of its propulsion-development program; no test, qualification or flight status is claimed. Partners shown (Gamyaa Aerospace for digital engineering and quality, iFab Innovations for embedded systems and firmware, iTelematics Software Private Limited for cybersecurity and AI, EV Society for skills and workforce) are proposed capability partners, not formal agreements.

- [APEX Rocket Systems — overview](https://aerospace.gamyaa.in/space/partners/apexrocketsystems): What APEX has built, the rocket as a system of systems, the engineer–build–prove–improve philosophy, Digital Twin plus physical testing, the ecosystem, roadmap and founders.
- [Engine](https://aerospace.gamyaa.in/space/partners/apexrocketsystems/engine): The demonstrator's published architecture, APEX's manufacturing-led approach, the path from requirement to verified engine and a functional engine model.
- [System](https://aerospace.gamyaa.in/space/partners/apexrocketsystems/system): Eighteen system domains with interfaces, evidence and partner capabilities; where APEX holds authority; review gates.
- [Build & Validate](https://aerospace.gamyaa.in/space/partners/apexrocketsystems/build-validate): From mission to flight in 24 stages; the confidence ladder, hardware-in-the-loop and the digital quality thread.
- [Digital Twin](https://aerospace.gamyaa.in/space/partners/apexrocketsystems/digital-twin): A configuration-aware Digital Twin that adds value to physical testing; instrumentation and traceable test records.
- [Roadmap](https://aerospace.gamyaa.in/space/partners/apexrocketsystems/roadmap): Built, active, planned and concept items without guessed dates; investor view and business model canvas.
- [Ecosystem](https://aerospace.gamyaa.in/space/partners/apexrocketsystems/ecosystem): A many-to-many map of 40 capabilities and their proposed partners, and where new partners can contribute.
- [Company](https://aerospace.gamyaa.in/space/partners/apexrocketsystems/company): APEX Rocket Systems, its founders Vibbhav Gopaal and Arcchit Gopaal, and how to discuss collaboration.
